title: Bulugh al-Maram
author: ibn-hajar
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's collection of the reports used as legal proofs, arranged by chapter of fiqh from purification to inheritance. It names the source collection for each report and grades its authenticity.
historicalContext: Written in Mamluk Cairo as a handbook for jurists and students. Its combination of legal arrangement and hadith criticism made it a standard text in Shafi'i and broader Sunni curricula.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
